page_title: KOL 1-5 RBL | FC Koln v RB Leipzig 15/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
90+3' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Florian Badstubner has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+2' The RB Leipzig players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
89' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
88' It's time for a substitution. Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) comes on in place of Max Finkgrafe.

87' A neat pass is well received by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
86' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Castello Lukeba will be replaced by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig).
85' RB Leipzig keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
83' That will be all from Benjamin Henrichs who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig).
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) coming on for Amadou Haidara.
82' 1 - 5 Goal! Benjamin Henrichs puts a cross into the box and finds Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:5.
80' Here is a change. Denis Huseinbasic is going off and Timo Schultz gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Christensen (1. FC Koln).
80' It will be a substitution. Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) is ready to enter the pitch as Sargis Adamyan walks off.
78' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.

77' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
76' Florian Badstubner interrupts the game. One of the players from FC Koln won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
74' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Benjamin Sesko.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) will replace Lois Openda.
73' Timo Schultz prepares a substitution. Faride Alidou is replaced by Damion Downs (1. FC Koln).
73' Today's match ends for Florian Kainz who will be replaced by Davie Selke (1. FC Koln).
72' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is shown a yellow card by the referee.

70' 1 - 4 Goal! Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Marvin Schwabe is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:4.
70' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
69' FC Koln hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

67' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) makes it 1:3. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from David Raum and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. Marvin Schwabe was helpless.
66' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

63' 1 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
61' A player from FC Koln commits a rough challenge. Florian Badstubner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
59' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

58' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
58' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
57' Surely that's handball by one of the FC Koln players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
56' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
55' The resulting corner, taken by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig), comes to nothing. The linesman makes the right call and RB Leipzig will have a corner.
54' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
54' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) brings an opponent down and Florian Badstubner interrupts the game.

53' RB Leipzig slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card for infringement.
48' Some patient build-up play from RB Leipzig as they look to unlock the defence.
46' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Referee Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Marvin Schwabe anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
45+2' A rebound spins to Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
45+1' The corner kick falls to Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), who does his best to finish. The snap shot, however, only marks the left post! The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
43' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
41' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
40' FC Koln are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

36' What a chance that is! Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
35' Florian Badstubner couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) and blew his whistle.
33' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) jumps into a tackle and Florian Badstubner signals a foul.
31' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.

31' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Marvin Schwabe pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
29' The RB Leipzig players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
28' RB Leipzig score a goal, but referee Florian Badstubner has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
28' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out for offside!
26' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
24' FC Koln players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
20' Great teamplay by RB Leipzig as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' 1 - 1 Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the left post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
17' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
15' 0 - 1 Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
14' RB Leipzig enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
11' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' FC Koln are seeing far more of the ball now.
6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
4' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

3' What a chance that is! Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
2' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle after Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
